briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 push AGI timelines forward as race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released multiple high-capability models this month, driving record investment. Regulatory scrutiny is rising while security gaps persist in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI launched o4 with advanced reasoning; Google deployed Gemini 3 achieving new benchmarks. Anthropic and xAI followed with Claude 4 and Grok-3 updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp and TSMC expansions added 1.2M GPUs. Microsoft and Google announced new $4B+ data center clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory frameworks slow US frontier progress enough for China to close the capability gap by 2028?
